memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
The LORD said to Moses, "Say to the Israelites: 'On the first day of
the seventh month you are to have a day of sabbath rest, a sacred
assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts. Do no regular work, but
present a food offering to the LORD'" - Lev 23:23-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This festival is marked by sound. Trumpet blasts rang out across
Israel, calling the whole nation to attention. It came at the start of
the seventh month, ten days before the Day of Atonement - a wake-up
call before the most solemn day of the year.

In Israel, trumpets summoned people to assemble, to move, to prepare.
The sound said: stop what you are doing and pay attention. Something
important is here.

Dear friend, God still sends wake-up calls. Sometimes through a
sermon that lands uncomfortably. Sometimes through a Scripture that
will not leave us alone. Sometimes through a crisis that strips away
our distractions. These are mercies, not accidents.

The danger is that we hear the trumpet and carry on regardless. Hebrews
warns repeatedly: today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your
hearts (Heb 3:15).

Scripture also speaks of a final trumpet, when the Lord Himself will
come down with the trumpet call of God and the dead in Christ will
rise (1 Thess 4:16). Believers hold different views on the timing of
these things, and we can hold those differences graciously. What is not
in question is that Christ will return.

Are you listening?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Has God been trying to get my attention about something?
2. What distractions make it hard for me to hear Him?
3. Am I living ready for Christ's return?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, open my ears to Your voice. Where You have been calling me and I
have ignored it, forgive me and help me respond today. Amen.
